system_name: ER TRIAGE ASSISTANT - DMGT Demonstration Severity Rule Engine
disclaimer: EDUCATIONAL PROTOTYPE ONLY: These logical IF/THEN demonstration rules are designed solely for educational showcase (DMGT / ADSA coursework). They do NOT constitute medical advice, diagnosis, or clinical triage protocols. Real medical triage requires licensed clinical professionals (e.g., ESI, MTS, CTAS protocols).

LEVEL_1_RESUSCITATION.name: Level 1 - Immediate / Resuscitation
LEVEL_1_RESUSCITATION.clinical_urgency: Requires immediate medical attention; life-threatening situation.

LEVEL_2_EMERGENT.name: Level 2 - Emergent / Very Urgent
LEVEL_2_EMERGENT.clinical_urgency: High concern condition; assessment recommended within 15 minutes.

LEVEL_3_URGENT.name: Level 3 - Urgent
LEVEL_3_URGENT.clinical_urgency: Potentially serious; requires evaluation within 60 minutes.

LEVEL_4_SEMI_URGENT.name: Level 4 - Less Urgent / Non-Emergency
LEVEL_4_SEMI_URGENT.clinical_urgency: Routine condition; stable for non-urgent evaluation.

emergency_warning_rules.explanation: Recorded oxygen saturation (SpO2) is dangerously low (< 90%), indicating potential respiratory failure requiring immediate airway and oxygenation evaluation.

emergency_warning_rules.condition_name: Acute Cardiac Alarm / Crushing Chest Pain with Collapse
emergency_warning_rules.explanation: Presence of acute crushing chest pain or unconsciousness flags suspected acute coronary syndrome or circulatory collapse, demanding immediate resuscitation bay assessment.

emergency_warning_rules.condition_name: Severe Hemodynamic Collapse (SBP < 80 mmHg or HR > 150 bpm / < 40 bpm)
emergency_warning_rules.explanation: Severe hemodynamic instability detected (systolic blood pressure < 80 mmHg or severe brady/tachycardia), indicative of decompensated shock.

high_concern_rules.explanation: Sub-optimal oxygen saturation (90-93%) or acute respiratory difficulty present. Patient requires urgent respiratory stabilization within 15 minutes.
High fever exceeding 39.5°C accompanied by systemic signs such as confusion or lethargy flags possible severe bacteremia or central nervous system infection.

high_concern_rules.condition_name: Acute Severe Abdomen or Suspected Internal Hemorrhage
high_concern_rules.explanation: Severe acute peritoneal signs or gastrointestinal bleeding warrant emergent surgical evaluation.
Acute focal neurological symptoms strongly suggest time-critical cerebrovascular incident (stroke protocol activation).

moderate_concern_rules.condition_name: Persistent Moderate Pyrexia or Dehydration Risk
moderate_concern_rules.explanation: Elevated body temperature (38.2 - 39.4°C) or moderate symptom severity requires diagnostic evaluation and symptomatic relief within 60 minutes.

moderate_concern_rules.condition_name: Suspected Closed Fracture or Deep Laceration
moderate_concern_rules.explanation: Orthopedic trauma or wound requiring x-ray evaluation, hemostasis, or wound closure within 1 hour.

default_rule.explanation: Vital parameters are within demonstrative normal limits and symptoms represent low-acuity complaints suitable for standard ambulatory clinic or queue.
